redacted.tasks: the per-task table names tasksource-v1's private training families (PLAN.md, data policy); the full result.json is in jaredpalmer/kev-private-train, runs/r22-readout/private-rows.json (scripts/private_rows.py restore)

metric_policy.coverage_at_error: in-sample maximum over confidence thresholds; not a deployed error guarantee
metric_policy.aurc: right-step integral over whole confidence groups
metric_policy.confident_error_rate: high-confidence errors divided by all questions
metric_policy.error_rate_at_0_9: errors divided by questions accepted at p_max >= 0.9
metric_policy.nll: exact from logits when recorded; otherwise from floored probabilities

gates.policy: Research screening only: 0.001 isolation; 5pp task regression; 70% heldout pair correctness; <=10% confident errors; no automatic release.

calibration_fit.role: in-trial screening; fitted on the training suite's calibration partition (held-out items of the training sources: in distribution); not a served or shipped temperature
